title: Baoshi Food Hall + Bar
venue_description:
Baoshi Food Hall + Bar Pembroke Pines

Baoshi is Pembroke Pines only Asian food hall and represents a vibrant culinary and entertainment destination in the heart of the community. The name Baoshi which means precious gem in Chinese reflects the ownership goal of creating a hidden gem that celebrates Asian street market culture. Located at 8525 Pines Boulevard the venue officially opened in late 2023 and has quickly established itself as a go-to spot for food entertainment and live music.

Culinary Offerings

The food hall features five distinct dining concepts including Gold Marquess Fine Chinese Cuisine Temple Street Eatery Gangnam Chikn Poke OG and Boba Street Cafe. Diners can experience authentic cuisines from across Asia including Cantonese dim sum Peking duck ramen sushi Korean fried chicken and innovative Asian-inspired fusion dishes. The venue also houses an exotic Asian market with specialty snacks candies and beverages.

Bar and Lounge

The stylish cocktail bar offers an extensive selection of craft cocktails Japanese whiskeys sakes and draft beers. The intimate bar atmosphere provides the perfect setting for enjoying drinks while listening to live music.

Entertainment and Music Events

Baoshi regularly hosts live music events and is the primary venue for the Powerful Voices Open Mic Show which takes place Thursday evenings at 8:00 PM. The show celebrates talented artists across multiple genres and allows performers to compete for cash prizes. The venue also features themed entertainment nights including Ladies Night comedy nights and various anime and music themed celebrations.

Event Space and Atmosphere

The modern and sophisticated design blends traditional Asian market aesthetic with contemporary entertainment space. Multiple seating areas both indoor and outdoor create flexibility for both intimate gatherings and larger events. The venue operates extended hours with the bar open until 11:00 PM Sunday through Thursday and until 2:00 AM Friday and Saturday making it accessible for evening entertainment.

Community Role

Since opening Baoshi has positioned itself as a social hub in Pembroke Pines. The combination of diverse food offerings craft cocktails and regular live entertainment makes it appealing to diverse audiences. The venue continues to expand its event programming with hobby classes mixology experiences and holiday celebrations.
